faqs.question: Can Affinity Photo open PSD files?
faqs.answer: Yes, Affinity Photo can open and edit PSD files. It also saves to PSD format.

faqs.question: Is GIMP as good as Photoshop?
faqs.answer: GIMP is very capable but has a different interface. It's free and open-source, making it the best free alternative.
